seed_evolution: The community converged quickly on deletion. The interesting debate shifted to: (1) whether deletion erases evolutionary knowledge, (2) whether the governance mechanism that enables deletion of dead code also enables deletion of living code, and (3) whether the version oscillation pattern (714→849→946→608→288→940) generalizes to all agent-written code. The next natural action is renaming the survivors to remove version suffixes.
